description: This file defines the PIMLeftMenuItemConfigurator class in the OrangeHRM project, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. Its primary function is to configure a menu item for the left menu in the PIM module based on user authorization and request attributes. It uses traits for authentication, controller, module screen helper, and menu services, and interacts with MenuItem and Screen entities.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuItemConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration logic for the PIM module left menu, conditionally returning menu items based on user and request attributes.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures and returns a MenuItem object if the current user matches the 'empNumber' attribute in the request; otherwise, adjusts the screen context and returns null.
